projects.title: AI Based Symptoms Checker
projects.description:
Developed an innovative AI-based Symptoms Checker application utilizing Python and MERN (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js) Stack.

Increased diagnoses accuracy by 90% and improved diagnosis time by 66% by utilizing machine learning and natural language processing techniques to create the algorithm which allowed for quick and accurate processing of symptoms.

projects.title: Open-Cart Automation Script
projects.description: Designed Automation Script using Java, Selenium, and Apache Maven Automation Tool to test various functions such as login, Product Search, Add to Cart, and Checkout Process on Open-Cart Platform. The Automation Script reduced the number of defects found by 20%, and increased the number of test cases being executed by 50%.
